title: Peyton's Place | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Steps from 30A’s boutique shops and gourmet dining.* Pet Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Blue Mtn Beach Regional Beach Access is only 1.1 miles away* 4 Bikes Included* Great Outdoor Areas for Dining
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Steps from 30A’s boutique shops and gourmet dining.* Pet Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Blue Mtn Beach Regional Beach Access is only 1.1 miles away* 4 Bikes Included* Great Outdoor Areas for Dining + Relaxing* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs every month from January through February. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please get in touch with us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Peyton’s Place, an exquisite 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath luxury retreat nestled along iconic 30A. Thoughtfully designed with sophisticated coastal elegance, this stunning residence offers the perfect blend of upscale comfort, modern style, and effortless relaxation. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by a light-filled, open-concept layout that sets the tone for refined coastal living. The seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen spaces creates an inviting atmosphere—ideal for entertaining guests or enjoying intimate family gatherings.The gourmet kitchen is a true centerpiece, showcasing quartz countertops, high-end stainless-steel appliances, and designer finishes. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a chef-inspired dinner, the kitchen is fully equipped for memorable meals, with seating for six at the dining table and four additional seats at the breakfast bar.The luxurious king primary suite offers a serene private retreat with spa-inspired finishes and a calming ambiance, while the thoughtfully designed guest accommodations provide comfort and flexibility for everyone in your group, including a guest suite with a queen bed and ensuite bathroom, an additional queen bedroom, a cozy daybed space, and a fun bunk room featuring two full-over-full bunk beds—perfect for families or groups traveling together.Perfectly situated within a private, gated community in prestigious Blue Mountain Beach, Peyton’s Place provides both seclusion and convenience. Spend your mornings biking to the sugar-white sand beaches, your afternoons exploring charming coastal towns, and your evenings savoring world-class dining under the stars. Come unwind, reconnect, and create unforgettable coastal memories at Peyton’s Place.** Please note: Pet Fee is $250/pet and is nonrefundable. Please note we can accept requests for 2 dogs under 25 lbs. or one larger dog. Pets are subject to approval.Peyton's Place is located in the charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Peyton's Place is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love to take a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy to drive to many locations, including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. The Bed Setup: 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 3: Daybed Guest Bedroom 4: 2 Full/Full Bunk BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
